text:
We often view home energy dashboards as tools for savings, but they introduce a hidden maintenance cost: data fatigue and sensor decay. A dashboard is only as good as the hardware feeding it. Over time, smart plugs lose connectivity, CT clamps drift in accuracy, and software integrations break during updates. 

Instead of just monitoring usage, you end up managing a complex network of sensors. You aren't just saving electricity; you are becoming a part-time systems administrator for your own utility data.
